problem_type: Generation selection and editorial timeline ownership were coupled
symptom: Regenerating a selected shot silently replaces and resizes already edited timeline cuts
direct_cause: Three generation controller paths call timeline reconciliation and the clip replacement helper clamps trims to a new source duration
class_root: A generation completion is not an explicit editorial command and cannot own authored timeline source windows
affected_population: Batch generation of an already placed shot
Previously trimmed clips and multiple uses of a shot
entry_points: Candidate selection and explicit timeline replacement
internal_only_reason: This is the Nomi internal split between candidate ownership and authored timeline state; provider documentation cannot decide it
invariants: Generation and candidate selection never alter existing timeline cuts
Explicit source replacement preserves timeline placement, visible duration, source in/out times, framing and audio
An insufficient candidate rejects the entire replacement
Candidate command feedback is visible inside the tray that owns the command, never under stacked card decoration

door_reduction.why_not: The automatic generation mutator is removed. Three explicit declarations/call boundaries implement one atomic editorial command; provider completion has no timeline write entry.

generality_proof: All automatic reconciliation call sites are removed. The sole explicit clip source helper validates the old source window against the new candidate before publishing any new timeline.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Reject insufficient sources and preserve the editorial source window
Publish an atomic explicit replacement and keep undo history

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Completion no longer invokes the timeline mutator
Candidate selection remains a node edit; a separate button is the sole timeline replacement trigger

recurrence.reason: Every future regeneration of an edited shot can silently alter authored timing
same_class_scan: door-map reconcileTimelineForUpdatedNodes finds three calls in generationRunController
door-map applyRegeneratedResultToClip finds the workbench store consumer
Read updateClipsBySourceNodeId and applyRegeneratedResultToClip trim/overlap mutations

prevention.invariant: The authored visible source window survives explicit replacement; generation does not mutate the timeline
prevention.strategy: Remove automatic mutation and enforce replacement at the shared source boundary

legacy_paths.rationale: Remove all three implicit reconciliation invocations

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: The application owns source windows and generation completion policy

migration: Existing clips retain their authored fields. New candidates require an explicit replacement. No disk migration is needed.
residual_risks: Real browser and GPU candidate replacement remains to be exercised

invariant_owner_layer.why: This shared clip source boundary enforces duration and trim preservation before publication.
